metadata.author: Claudia Robin Gunn
metadata.description:
Tune in to the beautiful chorus that our world makes - and add your voice to the choir. 

This album is an invitation for children to sing and learn about biodiversity, and some of the unusual and fascinating creatures we share our planet with.
